conceptual_statement: Ohio’s strongest Trust Hub evidence is OCILB five-trade commercial specialty licensing without a statewide general-contractor census, PUCO household-goods carrier authority that is publicly searchable but has no acquired complete current roster and uses carrier-specific tariffs, ODH Nursing Home and Residential Care Facility licenses kept separate from CMS, DFI/NMLS RMLA nonbank mortgage registration that is search-only plus HMDA 2025 market activity, ODI authorized legal insurers and Major Lines business-entity NPNs that must not be added, and IAPD Ohio state-IA firms that must not be summed with ERA, notice filings, or principal-office geography. Organizations and evidence records stay separate. Missing, restricted, and search-only sources are unknown — not zero.

release_gate.rule: All six specialist /ohio pages must return HTTP 200 as intended state intelligence pages, indexable and self-canonical, before Ask /ohio is indexable. Any one specialist failure fails the gate. Columbus/Cleveland/Cincinnati/Toledo/Akron/Dayton local routes are not published.

Separately 812 Residential Care Facility licenses. Never publish 1,735 Ohio senior facilities. RCF is Ohio's assisted-living class. Exact ODH↔CMS bridges: 0.

Market activity, not a lender count. Current RMLA company roster is OPEN_SEARCH_ONLY. Supporting separately: 610 CFPB 2025 mortgage complaints; 2,095 OHFA lender-county observations; 157 FDIC institutions.
Exact legal-company NAIC grain. Separately 23,922 Major Lines business-entity NPNs. Do not add them. Homeowners/Auto/Flood remain UNSUPPORTED exact product LOA under SQA-009.

intelligence_strip.grain: Separately 24 ERA, 2,733 notice filings, 426 principal-office overlay. Do not add them. Principal office ≠ registration. NOH ≠ final finding.

what_makes_ohio_different: Contractor: Ohio uses OCILB individual licensing for five commercial specialty trades rather than a universal state GC license, plus separate State Fire Marshal fire-protection certification.

Move: PUCO household-goods authority uses a state certificate identity, but the current statewide roster is search-only. Each carrier files its own tariff; Ohio does not use NC's one Maximum Rate Tariff.
Senior: ODH separately licenses Nursing Homes and Residential Care Facilities; RCF is Ohio's formal assisted-living class. State licenses and CMS certification stay separate.

Lender: DFI regulates RMLA nonbank mortgage activity while NMLS supplies public licensing infrastructure. RMLA covers multiple company activities and does not represent every mortgage lender because of statutory depository exemptions.

Insurance: ODI exposes a complete authorized legal-insurer universe plus a strong business-entity mailing-list generator with licensing-authority filters and a bounded but explicitly incomplete Administrative Actions Journal.

Investor: Ohio state-IA registration in IAPD is distinct from ERA, federal notice filing, and Ohio principal-office geography. Division Orders separately distinguish NOH allegations from final dispositions.

contractor.grain_note: Ohio does not have one statewide general-contractor license. 12,461 trade rows ≠ 12,461 unique contractors. Licensed individual ≠ associated company. Fire installer ≠ OCILB contractor. Search-only discipline is not zero.

move.grain_note: PUCO certificate ≠ USDOT ≠ MC. Search-only is not zero movers. Carrier-specific tariff ≠ statewide Maximum Rate Tariff. Tariff ≠ quote. Damage claim ≠ PUCO complaint.

senior.grain_note: Nursing Home ≠ RCF. Do not publish 1,735 Ohio senior facilities as a consumer denominator. ODH license ≠ CMS CCN. Assisted living maps to RCF. Navigator quality ≠ TrustHub ranking.

lender.grain_note: DFI = regulator. NMLS = infrastructure. HMDA applications are not lenders. RMLA search-only is not zero companies. Company ≠ MLO. OHFA names are not exact companies. FDIC ≠ RMLA.

insurance.grain_note: Legal insurer ≠ agency ≠ agent. NAIC ≠ NPN. Do not add 1,738 + 23,922. Homeowners/Auto/Flood remain fail-closed under SQA-009. Journal ≠ complete enforcement census. Order ≠ Notice.

investor.grain_note: Ohio Division of Securities = regulator. IARD/IAPD = infrastructure. Do not add 784 + 24 + 2,733 + 426. State IA ≠ ERA ≠ notice. Principal office ≠ registration. NOH ≠ final finding.
